message.content: Yes, this appears to be a splash/boot screen. A phone mockup displays a dark navy blue screen with a centered glowing blue rounded-square app icon containing a white **triangle** logo (with small dots beneath it, suggesting wheels/transit). Below the logo is the text "CHENNAI ONE" in bold white letters, with the subtitle "BUS · METRO · TRAIN" in lighter blue. At the bottom, small text reads "An initiative of CUMTA · Govt. of Tamil Nadu."
